description: The bar chart illustrates average performance values for five labeled methods in the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” The horizontal axis contains the method categories in left-to-right order: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS, with no explicit axis label. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks shown at regular 10-unit intervals. Each category is represented by a single solid-colored vertical bar: Standard is orange at approximately 52, Self-RAG is a light khaki/olive color at approximately 54, FactTune is light green at approximately 51, CInGS (w/) is steel blue at approximately 53, and CInGS is dark blue at approximately 59. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond being separate single bars per category, there is no legend, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis effects; the categories appear in a fixed labeled order rather than being sorted by bar height.
